With over 52,000 public charging stations, including more than 16,000 fast chargers, BMW is also expanding its own network, which is open to EVs of all brands. Brar said one in four BMW cars sold in India is now fully electric.

Significant reforms were also made to simplify settlement proceedings and ease compliance burdens for research entities.

items.summary: India’s expanding network of bridges, tunnels, expressways and faster trains is significantly cutting travel times across major routes. From the Delhi-Mumbai journey targeted to fall from 33 hours to 12 and the Delhi-Katra trip from 14 hours to six, to the Kosi Rail Mahasetu cutting an eight-hour journey to 30 minutes, infrastructure projects are reshaping connectivity. Vande Bharat services and planned high-speed rail corridors are expected to bring further reductions in journey times.
